governing_equation: d2u_dxi2 = 3 * reference_shear_stress * (bed_thickness + skin_thickness) * (1/skin_modulus - 1/bed_modulus) / (2 * transition_width) / cosh((xi - bed_thickness / (bed_thickness + skin_thickness)) / transition_width)**2

parameters.name: reference_shear_stress
parameters.justification: Mean shear stress transmitted through a barnacle base plate by the drag of its shell; the model is linear, so the compliance u(1)/tau does not depend on it.

parameters.name: transition_width
parameters.justification: Normalised width of the smoothed skin/bed interface (tanh step) in xi = z/(bed+skin), a numerical smoothing of the modulus jump; xi=0 at the primer, xi=1 at the surface.
